footer: Source: Banco Central do Brasil, Estatísticas do Pix. Transaction figures are SPI-settled only and exclude Pix settled on the participant's own books.

questions.name: How many SPI payments settled last complete month?
questions.description: Sum of QUANTIDADE. The reference month is the latest complete month of EstatisticasTransacoesPix.

questions.name: What value settled last complete month?
questions.description: Sum of VALOR. SPI only.

questions.name: What was the average ticket last complete month?
questions.description: sum(VALOR) / sum(QUANTIDADE) at the month grain.

questions.name: How many DICT users were registered?
questions.description: qtdUsuariosCadastradosDICTTotal for the latest complete snapshot. PF and PJ are the subtitle, not key counts.

questions.name: How did settled value and count move?
questions.description: SPI only. The open calendar month is excluded.

questions.name: Who pays whom, by month?
questions.description: All NATUREZA codes. Default is value. Count is the same grain, not a second population.

questions.name: Who paid whom in the last complete month?
questions.description: Rows are the receiver side (P, B, G). Columns are the payer side. The two sides are not added.

questions.name: How did the initiation mix shift?
questions.description: 100% of settled value. DICT is a Pix key, QRDN a dynamic QR, QRES a static QR, MANU manual details, INIC a payment initiator. AUTO, APDN and APES stay codes. The raw token of an unstated row is in the label.

questions.name: Pix, Pix Saque or Pix Troco?
questions.description: Finalidade is a table, not a primary chart. Nao disponivel stays visible.

questions.name: How did DICT users grow?
questions.description: Total, natural persons and legal persons. These are users, not keys.

questions.name: What is the month-end stock of keys by type?
questions.description: Month-end stock. Key counts are not user counts.

questions.name: Which participants hold the most keys?
questions.description: Not a transaction-volume ranking. Stock of keys at the latest complete snapshot.

questions.name: How much moved in this geography?
questions.description: Receiver view by default. Payer and receiver are never added.

questions.name: How many payments moved in this geography?
questions.description: Matches the value KPI's side and person type.

questions.name: How many distinct people, in one municipality?
questions.description: Shown only when the filter leaves a single municipality. Summing QT_PES across municipalities overcounts. No data for this period. means the selection is not one municipality.

questions.name: Which region moves the most?
questions.description: Includes Nao informado, labeled Unstated / other with the raw token.

questions.name: Which state moves the most?
questions.description: Every UF plus NAO INFORMADO. Click a bar to set the state filter.

questions.name: Which municipalities move the most?
questions.description: Sorted by value. Distinct people is filled only when one municipality remains. N/D stays as Unstated.

questions.name: Top 20 municipalities by value
questions.description: Optional companion to the table.

questions.name: How old are the people paying or receiving?
questions.description: PF rows only. Nao informado stays. Nao se aplica is excluded. Blank when a state or municipality filter is set, because this series has no municipality grain.

questions.name: Why is the age panel blank?
questions.description: Shown when a state or municipality filter is active.

questions.name: Payer region → receiver region, last complete month
questions.description: Optional matrix. Not a sum of the two sides: each cell is the flow from the payer region to the receiver region.

questions.name: How much was settled to these receivers?
questions.description: Sum of vllanliq. vlcompra and vldinespec are not used.

questions.name: How many payments were settled to these receivers?
questions.description: Sum of qtlanliq.

questions.name: What share of value went to micro and small firms?
questions.description: porte in Microempresa or Pequeno Porte, over the other receiver filters. The porte filter does not apply to this share.

questions.name: Which CNAE sections received the value?
questions.description: Pessoa fisica and Outros stay as their own bars.

questions.name: How is settled value split by firm size?
questions.description: Porte over time. A residual Outros is labeled Unstated / other.

questions.name: MEI, as published
questions.description: Field names are as published. S, N and Outros are not renamed.

questions.name: What is the average ticket by CNAE section?
questions.description: vllanliq / qtlanliq at the section grain.

questions.name: What is the average ticket by firm size?
questions.description: vllanliq / qtlanliq at the porte grain.

questions.name: How current is MED?
questions.description: MED is national, monthly, and published about 30 days after month-end.

questions.name: Which MED month is missing?
questions.description: A missing month is this sentence, not a zero.

questions.name: How many PIX were contested via MED?
questions.description: QtdePixcontestados. Not fraud cases.

questions.name: How many contests were accepted, and what is the published per-100k rate?
questions.description: Qtdecontestacoesaceitas and Qtdecontestacoesaceitasacada100mil as published. The rate is not recomputed.

questions.name: What return rate did BCB publish?
questions.description: PercentualdeDevolucao as published. Not recomputed.

questions.name: How many users carry a fraud mark?
questions.description: QtdeUsuarioscommarcacoesdefraude. A mark, not a fraud case.

questions.name: How many keys carry a fraud mark?
questions.description: QtdeChavesPixcommarcacoesdefraude. Keys, not users.

questions.name: Are contests, acceptances and the published return rate moving together?
questions.description: Axis starts at January 2022. Months BCB has not published are absent, not zero.

questions.name: Is suspected fraud growing faster than Pix?
questions.description: Approximate ratio computed by this portfolio; denominator is SPI-only (no on-us). Not an official BCB rate.

questions.name: Why was value not returned, and how do returns compare?
questions.description: Last complete MED month. The first three bars are non-return reasons. Full and partial returns are a comparison, not reasons.
